capabilities: Add sticky notes, shapes, frames and flowcharts to Canvas boards
Draw with pen, highlighter and smart shape recognition
Connect cards with formatted arrows and comment threads
Export boards to PDF, PowerPoint and SVG
Import boards from Miro, Excalidraw and other apps
disambiguation: Not a Miro integration or cloud service; it adds Miro-style tools to local .canvas files kept in the vault.
extras: No account, payment, advertising or telemetry; works offline. Install via BRAT or manually (directory publication pending). Optional CLI/MCP tools and font packs ship in separate releases. Line-to-line connections are experimental and off by default; large boards can be slow.
intentEvidence: Plan with sticky notes, sketch diagrams, draw and leave comments — all on Obsidian's own Canvas.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Canvas lacks Miro-style sticky notes, drawing tools, comments, layers and board export for visual planning.

relations.evidence: A visual workspace for your Obsidian notes, with Miro-style tools.
